widget.text: Everything Security Testing Orchestration in one place. The KPI strip summarises posture for the selected period (deltas compare with the previous period of equal length). Tabs below go deep: **Executive Posture**, **Issues & Severity**, **Targets & Coverage**, **Scanners & Scans**, **Exposure Aging & Remediation**, **Exemptions & Governance**, **Pipeline Integration** (STO correlated with CI builds, CD deployments and SCS artifacts) and **Usage**. Filters (Organization, Project, Target, Target Type, Scanner, Pipeline, Severity, Exempted) apply to every widget whose data carries that dimension. Tables link straight to STO targets, executions and exemptions.

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:latest_baseline_scan" l
| join view "view:sto:scan" s on s.internal_id = l.scan_internal_id
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = l.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = l.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:account_product" p on p.id = l.product_id and p.account_identifier = l.account_identifier
| join view "view:sto:target" t on t.id = l.target_id
| filter t.is_deleted = false
and s.created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and s.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate}
and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${target_filter_predicate}
and ${ttype_filter_predicate}
and ${scanner_filter_predicate}
and ${pipeline_filter_predicate}
| select {
h_l.org_identifier as org,
h_l.project_identifier as project,
distinct_count(l.target_id) as targets,
sum(l.critical) as critical,
sum(l.high) as high,
sum(l.medium) as medium,
sum(l.low) as low,
sum(l.critical * 16 + l.high * 7 + l.medium * 2) as risk_score,
round(sum(l.critical * 16 + l.high * 7 + l.medium * 2) * 100.0 / sum(sum(l.critical * 16 + l.high * 7 + l.medium * 2)) over (), 1) as risk_share_pct
}
| group_by h_l.org_identifier, h_l.project_identifier
| order_by risk_score desc
| limit 20

widget.subtitle: Projects ranked by weighted risk of latest baseline scans, with share of total risk; click a project to open its STO targets

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:issue_scan" x
| join view "view:sto:scan" s on s.internal_id = x.scan_internal_id
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = s.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = s.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:account_product" p on p.id = s.product_id and p.account_identifier = s.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:target_variant" tv on tv.id = s.target_variant_id
| left join view "view:sto:target" t on t.id = tv.target_id
| filter s.is_deleted = false
and s.created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and s.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate}
and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${target_filter_predicate}
and ${ttype_filter_predicate}
and ${scanner_filter_predicate}
and ${pipeline_filter_predicate}
and ${severity_filter_predicate}
| select {
x.title as issue,
x.severity_code as severity,
(case
when x.severity_code = "Critical" then 5
when x.severity_code = "High" then 4
when x.severity_code = "Medium" then 3
when x.severity_code = "Low" then 2
when x.severity_code = "Info" then 1
else 0
end) as severity_order,
p.pretty_name as scanner,
distinct_count(x.scan_internal_id) as scans_seen,
distinct_count(tv.target_id) as targets,
sum(x.num_occurrences) as occurrences,
round(distinct_count(x.scan_internal_id) * 100.0 / max(distinct_count(x.scan_internal_id)) over (), 1) as recurrence_pct
}
| group_by x.title, x.severity_code, severity_order, p.pretty_name
| order_by scans_seen desc, severity_order desc
| limit 100

widget.subtitle: Issues reported again and again by scans: fix once, stop the noise. Progress = recurrence vs most-recurring issue

find view "view:sto:scan" s
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = s.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = s.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:account_product" p on p.id = s.product_id and p.account_identifier = s.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:target_variant" tv on tv.id = s.target_variant_id
| left join view "view:sto:target" t on t.id = tv.target_id
| filter s.is_deleted = false
and s.created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and s.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate}
and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${target_filter_predicate}
and ${ttype_filter_predicate}

| select {
h_l.org_identifier as org,

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:exemption" e
| left join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = e.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = e.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:target" t on t.id = e.target_id
| filter e.is_deleted = false
and e.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and (e.expiration is null or e.expiration >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp))
and ${org_filter_predicate}
and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${target_filter_predicate}
and ${ttype_filter_predicate}
and ${pipeline_filter_predicate}
and ${severity_filter_predicate}
| select {
h_l.org_identifier as org,
h_l.project_identifier as project,
e.issue_title as issue,
e.issue_severity_code as severity,
e.status as status,
e.type as exemption_type,
e.reason as reason,
(case when e.expiration is null then true else false end) as never_expires,
e.duration_days as duration_days,
e.created as requested,
e.expiration as expires
}
| order_by requested desc
| limit 200

queries.query:
find view "view:sto:scan" s
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = s.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = s.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:account_product" p on p.id = s.product_id and p.account_identifier = s.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:target_variant" tv on tv.id = s.target_variant_id
| left join view "view:sto:target" t on t.id = tv.target_id
| join view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" c on c.planexecutionid = s.plan_execution_id
| filter s.is_deleted = false
and s.created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and s.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate}
and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${target_filter_predicate}
and ${ttype_filter_predicate}
and ${scanner_filter_predicate}
and ${pipeline_filter_predicate}
| select {
h_l.org_identifier as org,
h_l.project_identifier as project,
s.pipeline_identifier as pipeline,
c.moduleinfo_repository as repository,
c.moduleinfo_branch_name as branch,
distinct_count(c.planexecutionid) as scanned_builds,
count() as scans,
distinct_count(s.product_id) as scanners,
round(sum(case when c.status = "SUCCESS" then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / count(), 1) as build_success_pct,
avg(c.build_duration) / 1000 as avg_build_duration,
max(c.planexecutionid) as exec_id,
max(s.created) as last_scan
}
| group_by h_l.org_identifier, h_l.project_identifier, s.pipeline_identifier, c.moduleinfo_repository, c.moduleinfo_branch_name
| order_by scanned_builds desc
| limit 100

widget.subtitle: Which builds, repos and branches get scanned, with build success and duration; click exec_id for a sample execution

queries.query:
with gates as (
find view "view:sto:scan" s
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = s.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = s.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:account_product" p on p.id = s.product_id and p.account_identifier = s.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:target_variant" tv on tv.id = s.target_variant_id
| left join view "view:sto:target" t on t.id = tv.target_id
| filter s.is_deleted = false
and s.created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and s.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate}
and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${target_filter_predicate}
and ${ttype_filter_predicate}
and ${scanner_filter_predicate}
and ${pipeline_filter_predicate}
| select { s.plan_execution_id as pe_id, count() as scans, distinct_count(s.product_id) as scanners, round(sum(case when s.status = "Succeeded" then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / count(), 1) as scan_success_pct }
| group_by s.plan_execution_id
),
stg as (
find view "view:pipeline:stage_execution" se
| filter se.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and se.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| select { se.plan_execution_id as pe_id,
sum(case when se.stage_type = "Deployment" then 1 else 0 end) as deploy_stages,
sum(case when se.stage_type = "SecurityTests" then 1 else 0 end) as security_stages }
| group_by se.plan_execution_id
)
find view "cd:pipeline_execution_summary_cd" c
| join gates g on g.pe_id = c.planexecutionid
| left join stg on stg.pe_id = c.planexecutionid
| select {
c.orgidentifier as org,
c.projectidentifier as project,
c.pipelineidentifier as pipeline,
c.status as last_status,
distinct_count(c.planexecutionid) as gated_runs,
sum(stg.deploy_stages) as deploy_stages,
sum(stg.security_stages) as security_stages,
sum(g.scans) as scans,
max(g.scanners) as scanners,
avg(g.scan_success_pct) as scan_success_pct,
max(c.planexecutionid) as exec_id
}
| group_by c.orgidentifier, c.projectidentifier, c.pipelineidentifier, c.status
| order_by gated_runs desc
| limit 100

widget.subtitle: CD pipelines whose executions include STO scans (security gates before deploy) by outcome; click exec_id to open a run

queries.query:
with lb as (
find view "view:sto:latest_baseline_scan" l
| select { l.target_id as target_id, sum(l.critical) as critical, sum(l.high) as high, sum(l.medium) as medium, sum(l.low) as low }
| group_by l.target_id
)
find view "cd:service_infra_info" c
| join view "cd:pipeline_execution_summary_cd" pe on pe.id = c.pipeline_execution_summary_cd_id
| join view "view:sto:target" t on t.name = c.artifact_image
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = t.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = t.account_identifier
| left join lb on lb.target_id = t.id
| filter t.is_deleted = false
and pe.row_created_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.row_created_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate}
and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${target_filter_predicate}
and ${ttype_filter_predicate}
| select {
h_l.org_identifier as org,
h_l.project_identifier as project,
c.artifact_image as target,
c.tag as tag,
c.service_name as service,
c.env_name as environment,
c.env_type as env_type,
max(lb.critical) as critical,
max(lb.high) as high,
max(lb.medium) as medium,
(case when max(lb.critical) > 0 then true else false end) as has_critical,
distinct_count(pe.planexecutionid) as deployments,
max(pe.row_created_at) as last_deployed
}
| group_by h_l.org_identifier, h_l.project_identifier, c.artifact_image, c.tag, c.service_name, c.env_name, c.env_type
| order_by critical desc
| limit 100

queries.query:
find view "cd:service_infra_info" c
| join view "cd:pipeline_execution_summary_cd" pe on pe.id = c.pipeline_execution_summary_cd_id
| left join view "view:sto:target" t on t.name = c.artifact_image
| filter c.artifact_image != ""
and pe.row_created_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.row_created_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate}
and ${project_filter_predicate}
| select {
c.artifact_image as image,
c.tag as tag,
c.service_name as service,
c.env_type as env_type,
(case when max(t.id) is null then false else true end) as known_to_sto,
distinct_count(pe.planexecutionid) as deployments,
max(pe.row_created_at) as last_deployed
}
| group_by c.artifact_image, c.tag, c.service_name, c.env_type
| order_by deployments desc
| limit 100

queries.query:
find entity "ssca:artifact" a
| join view "view:sto:scan" s on s.plan_execution_id = a.sto_pipeline_execution_id
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h_l on h_l.parent_unique_id = s.parent_unique_id and h_l.account_identifier = s.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:account_product" p on p.id = s.product_id and p.account_identifier = s.account_identifier
| left join view "view:sto:target_variant" tv on tv.id = s.target_variant_id
| left join view "view:sto:target" t on t.id = tv.target_id
| filter s.is_deleted = false
and s.created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and s.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate}
and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${target_filter_predicate}
and ${ttype_filter_predicate}
and ${scanner_filter_predicate}
and ${pipeline_filter_predicate}
| select {
h_l.org_identifier as org,
h_l.project_identifier as project,
s.pipeline_identifier as pipeline,
a.name as artifact,
a.tag as tag,
a.digest as digest,
p.pretty_name as scanner,
max(a.sto_critical) as sto_critical,
max(a.sto_high) as sto_high,
max(a.sto_total_vulnerabilities) as sto_total,
max(a.prod_env_count) as prod_envs,
count() as scans,
max(s.plan_execution_id) as exec_id
}
| group_by h_l.org_identifier, h_l.project_identifier, s.pipeline_identifier, a.name, a.tag, a.digest, p.pretty_name
